name: pure-insights-command-center
description: Pure Insights Command Center — operational analytics admin dashboard (CSV → PostgreSQL → Node.js/Express → React)

scripts.setup: npm run db:setup && npm run pipeline:install && npm run pipeline && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace client run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --workspace server run start
scripts.test: npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.verify: cd pipeline && .venv/bin/python -m pic_pipeline.cli cost && .venv/bin/python -m pic_pipeline.cli verify
scripts.verify:snowflake: cd pipeline && .venv/bin/python -W ignore -m pic_pipeline.cli export && .venv/bin/python -W ignore -m pic_pipeline.cli snowflake
scripts.lint: cd pipeline && .venv/bin/ruff check . && cd .. && npm --workspace server run lint && npm --workspace client run lint
